title: Localqw6 and omer hilesi
script:
-- LocalScript
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- GUI Çerçevesi Oluşturuluyor
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Localqw6"
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- GUI Çerçevesi
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.6, 0)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.2, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true -- Sürüklenebilirlik
frame.Parent = gui

-- Başlık
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Text = "omer MODS"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
title.Parent = frame

-- Butonlar
local buttonNames = {"CHAT SPAM", "OTO CHAR RANDOM", "Da+y#ma", "Bütün Her Şeyi Elime Küle Yap", "TROLL", "Localqw6 Hilesi", "Patlat Sunucu"}
local buttonColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), -- Chat Spam
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255), -- Oto Char
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), -- Da+y#ma
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0), -- Kule Yap
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), -- Troll
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), -- Hile
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255), -- Sunucu Patlat
}

local buttons = {}
for i, name in ipairs(buttonNames) do
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.1, 0)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1 + (i - 1) * 0.12, 0)
    button.Text = name
    button.BackgroundColor3 = buttonColors[i]
    button.Parent = frame
    buttons[name] = button
end

-- İşlevler
local chatSpamActive = false
buttons["CHAT SPAM"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    chatSpamActive = not chatSpamActive
    if chatSpamActive then
        while chatSpamActive do
            game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("LOCALQW6 MEGA BOMB CHAT 🔥🥶🤑", "All")
            wait(0.5)
        end
    end
end)

buttons["OTO CHAR RANDOM"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local charList = {"/char Mamiiste_wq", "/Char butoytan17", "/Char 1_3mre", "/Char Eu_Luis09"}
    local randomChar = charList[math.random(1, #charList)]
    game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(randomChar, "All")
end)

buttons["Da+y#ma"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local targetPlayer = game.Players:GetPlayers()[math.random(1, #game.Players:GetPlayers())]
    if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
        local character = player.Character
        local targetPosition = targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(5, 0, 5)
        character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
        wait(0.1)
        character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
    end
end)

buttons["Bütün Her Şeyi Elime Küle Yap"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if backpack then
        for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                tool.Parent = player.Character
            end
        end
    end
end)

buttons["TROLL"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, targetPlayer in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("Eşek", "All")
    end
end)

buttons["Localqw6 Hilesi"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Cabin-Roleplay-localqw6-crp-CREDITS-BY-M1zz-21991"))()
end)

buttons["Patlat Sunucu"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        obj:Destroy()
    end
    game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("Sunucu silindi", "All")
end)
